newsitem.title: USA: Sun Intl unit extends tender's consent date.
newsitem.headline: Sun Intl unit extends tender's consent date.

text.p: A unit of Sun International Hotels Ltd on Friday said it was extending the consent period in its tender offer for two series of mortgage notes.
The consent period, which would have expired on Friday, was extended to February 26, a spokesman said.

Sun said Resorts International Hotel Financing Inc made an offer to expire March 10 to buy for cash all of its outstanding $125 million principal amount of 11 percent first mortgage notes due 2003 and $35 million principal amount of 11-3/8 percent junior mortgage notes due 2004.
The price determination date was extended to February 21.
